source.method: pixel sampling and visual reading of the public App Store listing images; resurf.so itself was blocked by a bot challenge

tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page ground at the top of the store art (sampled #f3f3f3, fading to `paper` at the bottom).

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Chips, cards and the lower end of the ground gradient (sampled).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headline second line, chip labels and glyphs (sampled). 18.9:1 on `ground`, 21:1 on `paper`.

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Headline first line (sampled #727272–#787878). 4.3:1 on `ground`: headline sizes only (24px+, 3:1 rule).

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Quiet subtitles over the art (sampled). 2.3:1 on `ground`: decorative only.

tokens.name: amber
tokens.usage: Notes and PDFs chip glyph and label (sampled #cc9030–#d89024). 2.6:1 on `paper`: icons and fills; labels use `amber-text`.

tokens.name: ember
tokens.usage: Voice notes glyph and the "Synced with iCloud" pill (sampled). 3.5:1 on `paper`: icons and fills; labels use `ember-text`.

tokens.name: azure
tokens.usage: Screenshots chip and the "or your own AI key" pill fill (sampled). 4.1:1 against white text.

tokens.name: violet
tokens.usage: Links chip glyph and label (sampled). 3.5:1 on `paper`: icons; labels use `violet-text`.

tokens.name: leaf
tokens.usage: Videos chip glyph and label (sampled #18b43c–#30a818). 3.1:1 on `paper`: icons; labels use `leaf-text`.

tokens.name: amber-text
tokens.usage: Derived, not sampled: `amber` darkened for text. 4.4:1 on `paper`, use at 18px+ or bold.

tokens.name: ember-text
tokens.usage: Derived: `ember` darkened for text. 4.7:1 on `paper`.

tokens.name: violet-text
tokens.usage: Derived: `violet` darkened for text. 5.8:1 on `paper`.

tokens.name: leaf-text
tokens.usage: Derived: `leaf` darkened for text. 5.3:1 on `paper`.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Centred two-line headline over the art: first line `ink-soft`, second `ink`.
styles.sample: Dump it now. Sort it later.

styles.name: chip
styles.usage: Tilted chip labels on an 800px-wide artboard (about 2.75% of width).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Chip icon-to-label gap (approximated from the art).

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Pill vertical rhythm.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Chip side padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Headline to first chip.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Chips and status pills.

tokens.name: radius-device
tokens.usage: Device screen corners in mockups (approximated).

radius.note: Radii are read by eye from the store art; chips are fully round.

tokens.name: shadow-chip
tokens.usage: Soft lift under tilted chips. Estimated from the art; no value was measurable.
